pages.text: Tanks store $(l)32,000 mB$() (32 buckets) of a single fluid:$(br)$(li)the $(l)Liquid Tank$() (cyan trim) takes liquids: water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, Acid, liquids of other mods;

$(li)the $(l)Gas Tank$() (amber trim) takes gases: biogas, methane, Steam, gases of other mods.$(br)Fill them with the matching $(l:cables/cables)pipe$(/l): a $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l) or a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l). A Liquid Tank also takes and gives $(l)buckets$().$(br2)Tanks are $(l)passive$(): they never push anything out. To empty one into a machine,

right-click the arm of the pipe that touches it, so the pipe $(l)pulls$() from the tank (an orange collar shows it). The window on every side shows the fluid inside, with its own colour, up to its level (gases look hazy); right-click a tank with an empty hand to read the exact amount.

A tank is a handy buffer: put one between a Methane Extractor and the Gas Turbines, or between a Water Pump and a Fission Reactor, and it keeps the flow going when production dips.$(br2)Breaking a tank $(l)empties it$().
